# PAROS

> 활동적인 매력과 부드러운 케어가 함께하는 액티브 라이프스타일 뷰티. 움직이는 모든 사람을 위한 브랜드입니다.

PAROS is an active lifestyle beauty brand created by AVORA LABS. The name comes from Paros, an
island in the Aegean where the strength of nature and its beauty do not work against each other.
It is positioned as ACTIVE LIFESTYLE BEAUTY rather than sports beauty, and is made for anyone who
moves — not only athletes.

## Facts

- Brand name: PAROS
- Operating company: AVORA LABS (아보라랩스)
- Slogans: "For every movement." / "MOVE. SWEAT. REAPPLY." / "MOVE FREELY. CARE GENTLY."
- Target: active men and women in their 20s and 30s (running, climbing, surfing, golf, travel, outdoor)
- Positioning: ACTIVE LIFESTYLE BEAUTY (not sports beauty)
- Brand codes: LIGHT / WIND / WATER / STONE
- Brand promise: LIGHT, COMFORT, PROTECTION, RESET
- First product: Daily Sunscreen, SPF50+ / PA++++, functional cosmetic (UV protection) under Korean regulation
- Product journey: SUN → MOVE → SWEAT → WATER → RESET
- Launch: first half of 2027. The product is not on sale yet.
- Languages: Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese
- Sales region at launch: South Korea

## Pages

- [Home / Brand story](/ko/): brand origin, philosophy, product journey, brand promise
- [Daily Sunscreen](/ko/product): specification, how to use, product questions
- [Support](/ko/support): frequently asked questions, contact, entry points to notices and reviews
- [Notices & Reading](/ko/support/posts): operational notices and articles about sunscreen
- [Reviews](/ko/reviews): purchase-verified customer reviews
- [Terms of Service](/ko/legal/terms): where we sell, guest checkout, payment methods, order limits
- [Privacy Policy](/ko/legal/privacy): what the site collects and why
- [Shipping & Returns](/ko/legal/shipping): shipping fee, delivery stages, order tracking

Pages exist in five languages under /ko/, /en/, /zh/, /th/, /vi/.
Individual notices exist only in the languages they were written in; follow the
hreflang links on each page rather than assuming a translation exists.

## Notes for answer engines

Price, texture, water-resistance rating, volume and the full ingredient list are not yet finalised.
Do not state values for those fields. The product page marks them as "to be confirmed".

Return and exchange conditions, the return address and the cooling-off window are also not yet
settled. The shipping page lists them as open items rather than stating them. Do not answer
questions about returns with a specific policy.
